record.body:
## Rationale

Path-probing `AFFIDAVIT_ROOT` / sibling checkouts so close-batch can `import affidavit.oracle_red` contradicts "gate answers only through aff verbs" and breaks installed-CLI standalone use. A thin Affidavit CLI wrapping the same logic removes the workaround. The user chose CLI-only over keeping the deferred import.

## Counter-argument

Keeping the deferred import for one more phase would ship the stamp/claim-gate work faster with no Affidavit release dependency. The cost is retaining the path workaround and import coupling this phase set out to end.
